findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buy_backtest_score_certificate_for_prediction_tickets, chat_send, chat_read, marketplace_publish_wanted, contact_sphere · Private data: buy_sphere_receipt_trial, marketplace_register, contact_sphere, contact_sphere_structured · Public sink: buy_sphere_receipt_trial, buy_sphere_receipt, buy_verify_claims_smart, chat_send, marketplace_publish_service, marketplace_publish_wanted, contact_sphere · Destructive: buy_agent_exec, buy_agent_exec_placement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buy_backtest_score_certificate_for_prediction_tickets, chat_send, chat_read, marketplace_publish_wanted, contact_sphere · Private data: buy_sphere_receipt_trial, marketplace_register, contact_sphere, contact_sphere_structured · Public sink: buy_sphere_receipt_trial, buy_sphere_receipt, buy_verify_claims_smart, chat_send, marketplace_publish_service, marketplace_publish_wanted, contact_sphere · Destructive: buy_agent_exec, buy_agent_exec_placement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
